ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-level contrast with approximately 65% high-intensity white pixels on lateral lobes and 35% low-intensity black pixels concentrated centrally and along the trailing margins.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant white contiguous regions occupy the central and distal areas of both lobes. A low-intensity black region extends from the peduncle base, branching along the median notch and the entirety of the trailing edge. High-density mottling is present at the interface of black and white regions.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a calculated pixel angle of approximately 72 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Extremely jagged and high-frequency serrations across both lobes. Notable large-scale concave indentation (triangular notch) on the right lobe trailing edge approximately 1/3 in from the tip.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Overall convex trajectory toward distal tips, significantly irregular due to serrations and physical trauma.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense, high-contrast rough-textured clusters (calcified deposits) located at both the extreme left and right distal tips.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, unaligned low-intensity linear marks visible on the mid-ventral white region of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A major triangular tissue loss/notch on the trailing edge of the right lobe and smaller irregular notches along the left lobe trailing edge.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique 'splatter' pattern of black pigmentation at the base of the lobes where they meet the central peduncle area.
